notes: Original source front image retained; complete outer rim annotated individually. Pixel-edge-assisted ellipse fitting checked visually, never an automatic partial-circle Hough result.
Concavity, hidden barrel and physical fitment cannot be measured from a single front photograph.
Original actual front photograph on a textured gray wall; dark barrel visible behind lower windows must not become opaque front metal.

The 16 hole polygons follow the actual photo colour edges: ten spoke windows, five mounting bores and the valve opening. The gray wall and dark barrel behind windows are excluded from the front solid. A small dark rim reflection is not classified as a hole.

2026-10-11: Face, main apertures, rim steps and finish reviewed individually. New depths, spoke crowns and hidden rear form remain visual estimates; OARTS replaces the photographed supplier center label in the 3D model.

visualReview.observedFace: Ten slim straight spoke ends; tapered scalloped root and five visible mounting bores.
visualReview.construction: Monoblock visual form; do not add perimeter fasteners absent in this photograph.
visualReview.contourTreatment: Existing subpixel contour self-intersections normalized through the same planar polygon repair used by the builder; every real opening and its source position is retained.
visualReview.bevelSamplingReview: Three explicitly reviewed 30-degree quarter-circle bevel bands retain the native photographic silhouette within the mobile per-face geometry budget; dimensional depth remains an estimate.
visualReview.boundedSamplingTrial: Explicit inner .030 and outer .026 radial edge limits are under review for the plain concavity profile; original photographic contours are unchanged. This sampling refinement changes neither native source outlines nor estimated depth.

edgeEvidence.review: All ten windows, five mounting bores and valve opening reviewed on full-resolution original photograph. Gray fabric texture, white FORGED ink on opaque rim and black barrel reflections do not change aperture geometry. Source bores are smooth photographed ellipses.
edgeEvidence.maximumNativePixelErrorMeaning: Conservative sum of clean native turned-arc fit residual and final C2 source-control residual. It is a photographic reconstruction bound, not manufacturer CAD or a claim of dimensional precision. Individual component errors are recorded separately.

longWallSourceEvidence.sourceBoundaryEvidence: Ten long tapered spoke pairs are visually continuous straight or gently curved physical walls in the original full-resolution bronze photograph. The previous subpixel color transition follows changing reflections along those walls. Each of the twenty runs is independently fitted without symmetry, preserving both native endpoints exactly. All hub fillets, outer arcs, native bores, valve, and other contour points remain unchanged.

edgeEvidence.nativeErrorMeaning: Conservative upper bound: previous native edge-fit error plus largest independent physical long-wall refinement deviation from the prior reflection-sensitive color contour. This is photographic evidence, not dimensional CAD accuracy.
